Specify span of time series (wrapper around tsbox::ts_span())

span.Rd

Specify span of time series (wrapper around tsbox::ts_span())

Usage

span(x, start = NULL, end = NULL, template = NULL, extend = FALSE)

Arguments

x

ts-boxable object to filter by span

start

start date, in any form to_ymd() reads

end

end date, in any form to_ymd() reads. A year, quarter or month given as end is included in full, as in p(): on monthly data span(x, 2010, 2010) keeps January to December 2010. A day is kept as is.

template

ts-boxable time series (see tsbox::ts_span)

extend

logical. If TRUE, a start before the data or an end after them pads the series with NA.

Value

filtered object of the same type as the input. Without start, end and template, x is fitted to the bank: cut at the bank's start and end and padded with NA to both (extend is ignored).

Examples

options(fcutils.bnk_start = as.Date("1990-01-01"),
  fcutils.bnk_end = as.Date("2030-12-31"))
quarterly_data_example |>
  span() # 1990Q1 to 2030Q4
#> # A tibble: 164 × 31
#>    time       E_NF_HI ECT_HI EMN_HI EWT_HI ERT_HI E_TRADE_HI E_TU_HI ETWTANS_HI
#>    <date>       <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>      <dbl>   <dbl>      <dbl>
#>  1 1990-01-01      NA     NA     NA     NA     NA         NA      NA         NA
#>  2 1990-04-01      NA     NA     NA     NA     NA         NA      NA         NA
#>  3 1990-07-01      NA     NA     NA     NA     NA         NA      NA         NA
